description: International Baseline Data is published by USDA Economic Research Service. The international baseline provides long-run agricultural supply, demand and trade projections. Its stated coverage is Major exporting and importing countries and regions; ten-year projection vintages. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. The provider says a new international projection analysis was not produced in 2026. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
